Presenting MAIN DEEWANA DIL DEEWANA FULL VIDEO SONG from ZAMEEN AASMAAN movie starring Sanjay Dutt, Shashi Kapoor, Rekha, Anita Raj in lead roles, released in 1984. The song is sung by Kishore Kumar and music is given by R. D. Burman, and music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: MAIN DEEWANA DIL DEEWANA
Singer: KISHORE KUMAR
Music Director: R. D. BURMAN
Lyricist: ANJAAN
Bharat Rungachary first film as director, he was the assistance of Hrishikesh Mukherji.
